findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spl_warrant_issue · Private data: spl_lab_auth, spl_signup, spl_agent_key, spl_zip, spl_unzip, spl_warrant_verify, spl_warrant_receipt · Public sink: spl_signup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spl_warrant_issue · Private data: spl_lab_auth, spl_signup, spl_agent_key, spl_zip, spl_unzip, spl_warrant_verify, spl_warrant_receipt · Public sink: spl_signup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
